source_row.acip: DE LTAR SKYE BA YIN TE, BSHES SPRING LAS, YI DVAGS RNAMS LA SOS KA'I DUS SU NI, , ZLA BA'ANG TSA LA DGUN NI NYI MA'ANG GRANG , ZHES GSUNGS PA'I PHYIR,
source_row.wylie: de ltar skye ba yin te, bshes spring las, yi dvags rnams la sos ka'i dus su ni, , zla ba'ang tsha la dgun ni nyi ma'ang grang , zhes gsungs pa'i phyir
source_row.english: It is a fact that they get this kind of sensation, for [Arya Nagarjuna's] Letter to a Friend states: For craving spirits, even the light of the moon In the spring is hot, and even the winter sun cold.
